pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with highly serrated, jagged edges. High-frequency pixel gradients at the interface between dark brown regions and light corridors. Spatial area is significantly larger on the upper neck compared to the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored negative space with multi-nodal junction points. Pathways are relatively thick and uniform on the neck but become narrower and more complex in the flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dense, short mane along the dorsal line of the neck providing a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background.
